data.explanation: This letter congratulates you on being nominated for an Erasmus+ exchange semester abroad. To proceed, you must upload your signed Learning Agreement to the Mobility-Online portal by the stated deadline; without it, the university cannot forward your application to the host institution. Note that today's date is well after the printed deadline of 15 May 2026, so if you have not yet submitted the document, reach out to the International Office right away to find out if it's still possible to proceed.
